text:
Jadual Elektrik Baharu: Lebih 23.6 Juta Pengguna Domestik Semenanjung Nikmati Kadar Lebih Adil
Putrajaya, 20 Jun 2025 – Lebih 23.6 juta pengguna domestik di Semenanjung akan menikmati kadar elektrik yang lebih adil dan progresif menerusi pelaksanaan jadual tarif elektrik baharu yang telah diluluskan oleh Kerajaan. Penetapan tarif ini akan berkuat kuasa mulai 1 Julai 2025 hingga 31 Disember 2027 di bawah kerangka kerja Kawal Selia Berasaskan Insentif (Incentive-Based Regulation - IBR), selaras dengan peruntukan Seksyen 26, Akta Bekalan Elektrik 1990.
Perubahan tarif elektrik bagi Tempoh Regulatori Keempat (Regulatory Period 4 - RP4) melibatkan penstrukturan semula tiga (3) komponen berikut:
(i) kadar purata tarif asas;
(ii) jadual tarif baharu; dan
(iii) mekanisme pelarasan kos bahan api.

text:
Penyelarasan Kadar Purata Tarif Asas
Kadar purata tarif asas diselaraskan berdasarkan anggaran kos pembekalan elektrik bagi tempoh RP4 dan ditetapkan pada kadar 45.40 sen/kWj berbanding 45.62 sen/kWj yang diluluskan pada bulan Disember 2024. Dengan pelarasan ini, purata kos keseluruhan tarif elektrik berkurangan sehingga 19 peratus berbanding Tempoh Regulatori Ketiga (RP3).

text:
Perubahan Struktur Tarif Elektrik Merangkumi Kategori Pengguna, Caj dan Insentif
Pengenalan jadual tarif baharu ini meliputi perkara berikut:
(i) perubahan kategori pengguna yang terbahagi kepada domestik dan bukan domestik berdasarkan penggunaan voltan sama ada voltan rendah, sederhana dan tinggi; dan
(ii) penetapan setiap caj bagi komponen tenaga, kapasiti, rangkaian dan peruncitan yang berdasarkan kos berkaitan.
Insentif Cekap Tenaga akan diperkenalkan sebagai galakan kepada 23.6 juta pengguna domestik yang mengamalkan penggunaan elektrik secara berhemah. Melalui insentif ini, pengguna domestik dengan penggunaan elektrik 1,000 kWj dan ke bawah dijangka tidak terkesan dengan pelaksanaan jadual tarif baharu. Selain itu, pengguna bukan domestik voltan rendah yang menggunakan 200 kWj dan ke bawah turut akan mendapat manfaat daripada insentif ini.

Pembaharuan Mekanisme Pelarasan Kos
Bagi komponen caj tenaga, mekanisme pelarasan kos bahan api baharu yang lebih dinamik iaitu Automatic Fuel Adjustment (AFA) akan menggantikan mekanisme Imbalance Cost Pass-Through (ICPT). Maklumat tersebut akan dilaporkan setiap bulan di laman sesawang ST.

text:
ADDRESSING ELECTRICITY BILL CONCERNS: AFA MECHANISM ENSURES TRANSPARENCY AND FAIR COST-SHARING SINCE JULY 2025
Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) notes concern raised by certain segments of customers regarding electricity bills, particularly on the Automatic Fuel Adjustment (AFA) component.
TNB understands the pressures of the cost of living and would like to provide an explanation on how the AFA mechanism works, as well as the measures implemented to protect customers.
AFA was introduced on 1 July 2025 following the restructuring of the electricity tariff, replacing the Imbalance Cost Pass-Through (ICPT) mechanism. As such, AFA is not a new charge and does not generate profits for TNB. AFA functions as a two-way mechanism to adjust for changes in fuel costs and foreign exchange rates.

text:
Domestic Customers Using 600kWh and Below Fully Protected
Domestic customers with monthly electricity consumption of 600kWh and below are fully exempted from AFA charges, whether in the form of a rebate or surcharge. In addition, customers within this usage range are also exempted from the 8% service tax and Retail Charge.
Under the new tariff structure, this group of customers also pays approximately 2% to 14% less compared with the previous tariff, depending on their level of consumption.

text:
Two-Way Mechanism: Sharing Benefits and Costs
When global fuel costs are lower, customers benefit through rebates, with the savings passed directly to their electricity bills. Since the implementation of the new electricity tariff, customers have received AFA rebates for nine consecutive months, from August 2025 to April 2026.
When global fuel costs are higher, the difference in costs is adjusted through a surcharge. The surcharge was only introduced in May 2026, when generation costs increased following the crisis in West Asia.

Total Rebates Exceed Surcharges
Since the introduction of AFA, customers have overall received greater benefits, with a total of RM3.1 billion in AFA rebates compared with RM0.8 billion in AFA surcharges.
In addition, the Government has channelled an additional RM435 million through the Electricity Industry Fund (KWIE) to cushion the impact of the AFA surcharge on customers.

September 2026 AFA Rate and Its Impact on Bills
The AFA rate for September 2026 is +3.67 sen/kWh. This information is updated and published monthly on www.mytnb.com.my/tariff following confirmation from the Energy Commission.
TNB would like to clarify that AFA does not result in a sudden increase in electricity bills.
Factors such as festive seasons, school holidays and working from home can influence household electricity consumption patterns, which in turn affect monthly electricity bills.

text:
Four Practical Steps to Reduce Your Electricity Bill
TNB is committed to helping customers manage their electricity consumption, starting with these four easy steps:
1. Monitor your consumption – Use the myTNB app to monitor your electricity consumption on a monthly and daily (for smart meter users) basis.
2. Practice energy efficiency – Set your air conditioner between 24°C – 26°C and use timers. Choose electrical appliances with a 4- or 5-star rating.
3. Switch to Time of Use (TOU) – Use electricity during off-peak hours, from 10:00pm to 2:00pm (Monday to Friday) and throughout the day on Saturdays, Sundays and Public Holidays, to enjoy lower tariff rates.
4. Invest in rooftop solar – Under the Solar ATAP and SuRIA Home initiatives, customers are eligible for rebates of up to RM3,000 for a 5kWac system, with a payback period of around 8 years.

TNB Committed to Supporting You
TNB remains committed to ensuring that every electricity bill paid by customers reflects the actual cost of electricity.
TNB would also like to emphasise that AFA is not a one-way mechanism. When costs decline, customers benefit from rebates, while when costs increase, the difference is shared. At the same time, domestic customers with monthly consumption of 600kWh and below remain protected.
For any enquiries regarding AFA or further information about your electricity bill, our customer service team is ready to assist you. Please refer to www.mytnb.com.my/tariff or contact us through:
1. 1300-88-5454: operating from 8:00am to 7:00pm on weekdays, and from 8:00am to 5:00pm on weekends and public holidays.
2. Private Message (PM) to TNB Careline Facebook
3. Direct Message (DM) to X @Tenaga_Nasional
4. E-mail to CareLine@mytnb.my

text:
RESPONS KEPADA ISU BIL ELEKTRIK: MEKANISME AFA PASTIKAN KETELUSAN DAN PERKONGSIAN KOS YANG ADIL SEJAK JULAI 2025
Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) mengambil maklum mengenai kebimbangan segelintir pengguna berkenaan bil elektrik, terutamanya berkaitan komponen Pelarasan Kos Bahan Api Secara Automatik (Automatic Fuel Adjustment – AFA). Kami memahami bebanan kos sara hidup dan ingin menjelaskan bagaima na mekanisme AFA berfungsi dan langkah -langkah yang telah dilaksanakan bagi melindungi pengguna.
AFA diperkenalkan bermula 1 Julai 2025 berikutan penstrukturan tarif elektrik sebagai ganti kepada mekanisme Imbalance Cost Pass -Through (ICPT). Justeru, AFA bukan caj tambahan baharu dan ianya tidak menyalurkan keuntungan terhadap TNB. AFA berfungsi sebag ai mekanisme dua hala untuk mengimbangi perubahan kos bahan api dan kadar tukaran wang asing.

text:
Mekanisme dua Hala: Kongsi Manfaat dan Kos
Apabila kos bahan api global lebih rendah, pengguna menikmati kadar rebat, dan jumlah penjimatan dipulangkan terus ke dalam bil elektrik. Sejak pelaksanaan tarif elektrik baharu, pengguna menikmati rebat AFA selama sembilan bulan berturut -turut dari Ogos 2025 hingga April 2026.
Apabila kos bahan api global lebih tinggi, perbezaan kos diselaraskan melalui kadar surcaj.
Surcaj hanya mula dikenakan pada Mei 2026 apabila kos penjanaan meningkat berikutan krisis di Asia Barat.

LEBIH LAPAN JUTA PENGGUNA DOMESTIK TERIMA MANFAAT MELALUI PENINGKATAN ARAS PERLINDUNGAN BIL ELEKTRIK
Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) menyambut baik keputusan kerajaan dalam terus memperkukuhkan mekanisme perlindungan buat pengguna domestik elektrik dengan menaikkan aras perlindungan daripada 600kWj sebulan kepada 800kWj sebulan.
Melalui keputusan ini, kesemua pengguna domestik TNB dengan penggunaan 800kWj dan ke bawah sebulan akan dikecualikan daripada dikenakan caj Pelarasan Kos Bahan Api Secara Automatik (Automatic Fuel Adjustment – AFA), cukai jualan dan perkhidmatan sebanyak 8%, dan caj peruncitan sebanyak RM10 di dalam bil elektrik bulanan mereka.
Pengukuhan perlindungan tambahan ini akan berkuat kuasa bermula penggunaan elektrik September 2026 hingga 31 Disember 2026. Bagi penggunaan bulan September, jumlah pengurangan akan dikreditkan di dalam bil elektrik bulan Oktober.

text:
INCREASE IN PROTECTION THRESHOLD TO 800KWH: CUSTOMERS TO RECEIVE PRO-RATED CREDIT IN OCTOBER 2026 BILL
Following the government’s announcement on 17 September 2026 to increase the protection threshold for Domestic customers from 600 kWh per month to 800 kWh per month, Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) wishes to explain the credit method of benefits for September’s consumption.
With the increase in the protection threshold, Domestic customers with monthly consumption of 800 kWh and below from September to 31 December 2026 will enjoy full exemption from:
• Automatic Fuel Adjustment (AFA) charge,
• RM10 Retail Charge, and
• 8% Service Tax.
For eligible customers, the adjustment of the above charges for September will be calculated on a pro-rated basis and credited directly into the October 2026 bill. The adjustment amount will be reflected in the customer’s bill under “PELARASAN BIL (SEP 2026)” and “PELARASAN CUKAI PERKHIDMATAN (8%) (SEP 2026)”.

text:
How does the Automatic Fuel Adjustment (AFA) mechanism work and what does it mean for customers like me?
The Automatic Fuel Adjustment (AFA) mechanism works by making electricity tariffs more transparent, fair, and responsive to actual market conditions. It allows automatic monthly tariff adjustment based on current fuel prices and foreign exchange rates.
This means:
You get a more accurate reflection of energy costs
Smaller and regular adjustments that avoid price shocks
It encourages smarter and more efficient energy usage
Overall, the AFA mechanism helps create a more stable and predictable electricity pricing system for consumers.

text:
How is the Automatic Fuel Adjustment (AFA) rate calculated and adjusted?
The monthly AFA rate will be calculated based on the latest projection of global fuel prices and foreign exchange rates. Once the generation costs are actualised, any differences will be reflected as adjustments in the AFA rate for the upcoming months. This ensures that the AFA charged in the customers’ electricity bill corresponds to the actual cost of generating electricity.

text:
How does the AFA rate affect my bill?
It is a charge (in the form of rebate or surcharge) that is applicable for every kWh of electricity consumed. The calculation of AFA rate in the electricity bill will be energy (kWh) consumed in a month multiplies by the AFA rate (in sen/kWh). The AFA charge will then be added to (if it is surcharge) or subtracted from (if it is rebate) your current bill amount. As a result, customers may see a corresponding change in their total electricity bill. We encourage customers to adopt energy efficiency habits to help manage their overall electricity usage and costs.

Eligible customers include:
Domestic customers with monthly usage of 1,000 kWh or less
Non-Domestic Low Voltage customers with monthly usage of 200 kWh or less

text:
Bagaimana Mekanisme Pelarasan Kos Bahan Api secara Automatik berfungsi dan membantu saya sebagai pengguna?
Dengan adanya mekanisme Pelarasan Kos Bahan Api secara Automatik, tarif elektrik lebih telus, adil dan responsif terhadap keadaan pasaran bahan api semasa. Ia melaraskan bil elektrik pelanggan berdasarkan kepada kos bahan api semasa dan kadar pertukaran mata wang asing.
Ini bermakna:
Anda mendapat kos tenaga yang lebih tepat
Pelarasan bulanan yang minima dan konsisten dapat mengurangkan kejutan harga yang mendadak
Ia menggalakkan penggunaan tenaga yang lebih bijak dan cekap
Secara keseluruhan, mekanisme ini membantu mewujudkan sistem penetapan harga elektrik yang lebih stabil dan boleh dijangka untuk pengguna.

text:
Bagaimanakah kadar Pelarasan Bahan Api Secara Automatik (AFA) dikira dan diselaraskan?
Kadar AFA bulanan dikira berdasarkan unjuran harga bahan api global dan kadar tukaran wang asing semasa. Setelah kos sebenar penjanaan dimuktamadkan, sebarang perbezaan akan diambil kira sebagai pelarasan dalam kadar AFA bagi bulan-bulan berikutnya. Ini memastikan caj AFA dalam bil elektrik pelanggan mencerminkan kos sebenar penjanaan elektrik.

text:
Bagaimanakah kadar AFA memberi kesan kepada bil saya?
AFA adalah caj (dalam bentuk rebat atau surcaj) yang dikenakan bagi setiap kWj tenaga elektrik yang digunakan. Pengiraan kadar AFA dalam bil elektrik adalah berdasarkan jumlah penggunaan tenaga (kWj) dalam sebulan didarab dengan kadar AFA (dalam sen/kWj). Caj AFA akan ditambah (jika surcaj) atau ditolak (jika rebat) daripada jumlah bil semasa. Justeru, pelanggan mungkin melihat perubahan pada jumlah bil elektrik. Kami menggalakkan pelanggan mengamalkan amalan penjimatan tenaga bagi mengurus penggunaan elektrik dengan lebih berhemah.

text:
Bagaimana pula dengan penggunaan dari Oktober hingga Disember 2026?
Aras perlindungan 800 kWj sebulan terus berkuat kuasa bagi penggunaan elektrik sehingga 31 Disember 2026.
Sepanjang tempoh ini, pelanggan domestik dengan penggunaan 800 kWj dan ke bawah sebulan akan menikmati pengecualian Caj AFA, Caj Peruncitan dan Cukai Perkhidmatan 8%.

Siapa yang dilindungi
Bagi 85% pelanggan Domestik yang menggunakan 800 kWj dan ke bawah sebulan, mereka akan terus menikmati pengecualian daripada AFA, Caj Peruncitan dan SST 8%, manakala pelanggan yang menggunakan 300 kWj dan ke bawah sebulan turut dikecualikan daripada Kumpulan Wang Tenaga Boleh Baharu (KWTBB).
